# EduTimes Africa

> Pan-African education media platform connecting education professionals, news, and opportunities across Nigeria, Kenya, and the broader African continent.

EduTimes Africa serves as a comprehensive hub for education news, career opportunities, and professional networking across East Africa, West Africa, and Southern Africa. The platform connects educators, policymakers, and students with resources, job opportunities, and critical updates on education policy and initiatives.
